Re-arming is O(1) — a generation bump, a cursor reset, a cancel-word clear — and workers reuse their cached contexts, so a re-run pays neither the descriptor pickle nor the region create nor the worker-side re-attach. A view-collected run hands its region to the view; the next run restages into a fresh one (the mirror of mizu). Close with `close()` (or a with block) to unlink the region. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [pool]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [pymizu.Pool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The [`Pool`](`pymizu.Pool`) to run on. [x]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [\_Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The data to map over. return the run's map handle. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/shikokuchuo/pymizu/blob/main/python/pymizu/_map.py#L2178-L2274){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python run( x=None, timeout=None, ) ``` ::: #### Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [x]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [\_Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Replaces the staged data for this and later runs. When both the staged and the replacement x are raw-buffer eligible with the same dtype and length, the swap is an in-place memcpy over the region's x section — the iterate-over-same-shape loop (optimizer steps, simulation sweeps) runs at memcpy cost, skipping the region create and the worker-side re-attach. Any other x restages transparently on this run. [timeout]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Seconds before the run's submission gives up; on expiry the tasks already in are cancelled and the TIMEOUT [`Sentinel`](`pymizu.Sentinel`) is returned (no handle). The collection deadline is the handle's `collect()`. ::: #### Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ The run's map handle — collected exactly once, by]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `collect()` (blocking) or `collect_async()` (event-driven). A clean value collect keeps the stage for the O(1) re-arm; a view collect hands the region to the view, and an unclean run (timeout, an error, a worker death) drops it — the next run restages into a fresh one either way. :::
